reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001218 (the melody read from 001218a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 3 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. B. B. McKinney's dates (1886–1952) are from https://hymnary.org/person/McKinney_BB (McKinney, B. B., 1886-1952); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B._B._McKinney (Baylus Benjamin McKinney, July 22, 1886 - September 7, 1952); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n85142894 (McKinney, B. B., 1886-1952); CCEH's page gives only the year 1921. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1921, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001218a.nwc).
